accounting_partition.all_sites: Retain every sample/site in each arm, including common and non-CommitAt sites. None discarded to force a target difference.
accounting_partition.basis: Disjoint raw allocation samples by full leaf+stack; never sum cumulative overlapping parent/child rows. Bytes and objects separate.
classes: exact direct measured CommitAt line ancestry
accounting_partition.normalization: Raw division uses exact N/remainders. Never divide unfiltered whole-profile totals by128, round away remainder, or infer one256B allocation from a +2 median.
accounting_partition.residual: For each metric retain signed raw-loop total minus exact-loop-ancestry attributed profile delta as UNASSIGNED cross-window residual, with both operands and windows. Broader whole-profile total has a different denominator. Retain unmatched/unknown site totals and decoder/profile gaps separately. Nonzero/negative residual is not a removable product cost.
accounting_partition.site_causality: Observed exact-loop ancestry supports that observed site only. No demonstrated recurring avoidable dynamic site plus safe lifetime witness => STOP repair, no speculative product/layout/capability change.

profiles.after: Two GCs then after.allocs.pprof after original generation Stats/report, before original Close.
profiles.before: Two GCs then before.allocs.pprof before original Open.
profiles.decode_interface: Existing pinned go tool pprof through maintained Runner.command after producer closure. Retained recipe: -sample_index=alloc_space -base=before.allocs.pprof <exact arm ELF> after.allocs.pprof, corresponding alloc_objects; retain unfiltered -raw and original exits. No new decoder/controller here.
insufficient: a chosen subset of expected48B leaves
required_views: Complete unfiltered raw profiles and retained after-minus-before delta
alloc_space after-minus-before against exact arm ELF
alloc_objects after-minus-before against exact arm ELF
Every site and full stack identity including inline/unknown/negative samples; top/list supporting only
profiles.scope: Broader than raw loop; includes original Open/seed/setup, background, Stats, observer/profile work. Original Close outside both profiles.

raw_window: ReadMemStats immediately adjacent to original128-call loop, after ResetTimer and before StopTimer. Process-wide concurrent/background/runtime work can enter; two STW reads perturb timing. Testing B/op uses other snapshots, not asserted equal.
required_raw: Before/After TotalAlloc, Mallocs, Frees and all BySize buckets
Counters monotonic and bucket sizes match; absent/regressing data is adverse
LoopSeamBefore/After and every phase are separate atomic snapshots
original calibration/benchmark exits, generation metric and checked Close
